opening.argument: The narrator warns that “Your money can also be wasted” and describes the activity as “fooling people.” The explanation makes the concern concrete: earnings depend on building a team, with income flowing between people who join and those above them, rather than on a real product. The FORSAGE registration and payment material appears on screen as part of that examination, not as an endorsed offer. Taken together, the warning, the criticism, and the explanation of the recruitment-dependent structure show an investigation of Forsage, not an invitation to join, pay, or provide information.
